name: Rest
description: Sleeps, reads, stares at the ceiling. Recovers from stress much faster.

name: Infirmary
description: Tends the wounded: they heal faster and the group calms down. Can treat someone on the spot, for extra medicine.

name: Kitchen
description: Stretches the rations (each cook saves a fifth; with the pantry, up to 55% in all). A hot meal lowers everyone's stress.

name: Workshop
description: Strips scrap (3 scrap → 1 component every 2 h) and speeds up crafting with their Craft.

name: Guard
description: Watches the entrance. If there's a raid, defends with Endurance and Nerve.

name: Radio assistant
description: Sweeps the dial while you're away, and is there when scheduled bulletins air (food drops, warnings, stashes). The company calms everyone.

name: Training
description: Trains with the others. Whoever knows more teaches.
